names.note: Read out of saint.gr’s heading «Όσιος Ιωάννης ο Χοζεβίτης επίσκοπος Καισαρείας».
The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 1024 is «Святитель Иоанн Хозевит, Кесарийский, епископ»; the name and its epithet are all of it that is neither rank nor office.

floruit.note: The century the Russian calendar prints after his name, «Прп. Иоанна Хозевита, еп. Кесарийского (VI)». The folder held no date at all before this reading.

feast.note: His name page lists one other day, «28 октября». One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, 3 октября ст. ст. — «Прп. Иоанна Хозевита, еп. Кесарийского (VI).»
source.note: The rank is the alt text of the one icon the page sets over the whole day, «Совершается служба на шесть» — a service of six stichera.

attestations.note: The Russian agrees with the folder's office, bishop of Caesarea, and gives it the century the folder had no date without.
Not on doxologia.ro’s list for 3 octombrie (checked 2026-09-17); no other day checked.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr), 3 Οκτωβρίου — «Όσιος Ιωάννης ο Χοζεβίτης επίσκοπος Καισαρείας»

attestations.note: Not checked: pravoslavno.rs’s page for 3. октобар ст. ст. (civil 16 October) was not read (2026-09-17).
